xBRIEFInfo.description: chore(skills): delete deprecated deft-* skill redirect stubs

plan.title: chore(skills): delete deprecated deft-* skill redirect stubs

narratives.Description: Eight deprecated deft-* skill directories under content/skills/ only redirect to deft-directive-* successors and still inflate discovery/frontmatter cost. Removing them cleans Wave 1 deferred stubs called out by epic #2369 without relocating live skill bodies.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Delete content/skills/deft-build, deft-interview, deft-pre-pr, deft-review-cycle, deft-roadmap-refresh, deft-setup, deft-swarm, deft-sync (and matching content/.agents/skills mirrors if present). 2) Update REFERENCES.md and packs skill indexes that still name the stubs. 3) Grep for leftover deft-build/deft-swarm style references in templates/AGENTS and repoint. 4) Verify with pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/content-contracts and task packs:verify-drift if wired. 5) CHANGELOG note under Removed.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want deprecated deft-* redirect stubs removed, so that skill discovery and always-on frontmatter cost only carry live deft-directive-* skills.
narratives.Origin: Enriched for swarm launch from GitHub issue #2451 under epic #2369

narrative.Acceptance: Given the eight deft-* redirect stub dirs, when the story completes, then they are gone from the live skills catalog.
Given REFERENCES/packs skill indexes, when updated, then they point only at deft-directive-* successors.
Given pack-drift/content checks, when run, then they exit 0 without broken skill routing.
